My MACD + Stochastic RSI Rules — ADANIPORTS and Nifty 50 Backtest (Oct 2026)

Five timeframes, intraday and delivery, buy and sell tested separately, FYERS charges only (no slippage), ₹1,00,000 per trade. Education, not investment advice. Reports with every trade (entry/exit time and price, qty, each FYERS charge, MACD/signal/histogram and %K/%D values):

  • ADANIPORTS: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/ADANIPORTS_STOCH_MACD_REPORT.md (reports/adaniports/trades_all.csv)
  • Nifty 50: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STOCH_MACD_ABOVE0_N50_REPORT.md (reports/stochmacd_above0_n50/trades_all.csv)

1. The rules

Buy. All of these must be true on the same candle:

  1. MACD line above 0 and signal line above 0
  2. The gap is widening: histogram (MACD − signal) is positive and bigger than on the previous candle
  3. Stoch RSI blue line (%K) crosses above the orange line (%D) on this candle, with blue below 50

→ Buy at that candle's close, as soon as the cross is confirmed. Exit at the close of the first later candle where blue touches orange (blue ≤ orange). No stop-loss.

Sell (short) is the mirror: both MACD lines below 0, the gap widening downward, blue crosses below orange with blue above 50 → short at that close, and cover at the close of the candle where blue touches orange again.

Settings MACD 12/26/9, Stoch RSI 3/3/14/14. Intraday trades are squared off at the close of the last candle starting before 15:15. Delivery buys pay cash-delivery charges; overnight shorts pay stock-futures charges. Same-day round trips pay intraday charges.

Costs (FYERS, ₹1L in and ₹1L out): intraday ≈ ₹83 (0.08%) · delivery buy ≈ ₹284 (0.28%, of which STT is ₹200) · futures short ≈ ₹104 (0.10%). Full rate list: brokerage ₹20 or 0.03% (intraday/futures) / 0.3% (delivery) per order, whichever is lower; STT 0.025% sell (intraday), 0.1% both sides (delivery), 0.05% sell (futures); NSE 0.0030699% (equity) / 0.0018299% (futures); SEBI ₹10/crore; IPFT ₹0.01/crore; stamp 0.003% / 0.015% / 0.002% on buy; GST 18%; DP ₹14.75 per delivery sell. Not included: income tax, FYERS' ₹59 auto square-off fee, and real futures lot sizes.

Daily——874, −₹21k615, −₹2.18L
  • All 18 versions lose money, even with FYERS charges only and no slippage. Win rates are 29–41%.
  • There's almost no edge before costs. The average move per trade ranges from −0.25% to +0.26%, against FYERS charges of 0.08–0.28%. The two closest are daily delivery buys (+0.26% move vs 0.285% cost, −₹21k; the second half since 2018 made +₹25k) and 4-hour delivery buys (+0.26% vs 0.28%, −₹5.5k; first half +₹17k, second half −₹23k). Neither is consistent.
  • The ADANIPORTS sell profits were luck. Daily sells made +₹9.6k on ADANIPORTS but −₹2.18L across Nifty 50, and 1-hour delivery sells made +₹6.3k vs −₹85k.
  • Why trades are rare: on Nifty 50 1-hour, 323,701 candles → 157,330 with both MACD lines above 0 → 34,421 also with a widening gap → 5,578 also with a blue-over-orange cross → 1,181 also with blue below 50.
  • Why trades are short (about 3–4 candles): orange (%D) is only a 3-candle average of blue (%K), so blue touches it again almost immediately.

4. Lesson

The entry finds moments of strong momentum where the Stoch is still "cheap". The touch exit then leaves within 3–4 candles, before the move can pay for the charges. Don't trade these rules as they are. If testing further, change the exit, not the entry: hold until the MACD histogram turns, or use a swing stop plus 2R target. Delivery buys on daily or 4-hour are the only versions worth a second look.
